verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or portability feature: nothing about bulk export, open formats such as CSV or JSON, or an offboarding or account-exit path. The v2 REST API with Bearer tokens and cursor pagination is only a developer building block from which a user could build an export. Custom dashboards and reports are an adjacent feature with no stated export capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
